```python
def dijkstra(nstates, indptr, dsts, ws, sources):
    dist = [INF] * nstates
    pv = [0] * nstates
    pk = [-1] * nstates
    heap = []
    for s in sources:
        dist[s] = 0
        heap.append((0, s))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push = heapq.heappush; pop = heapq.heappop
    settled = 0
    while heap:
        d, u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        settled += 1
        base = indptr[u]; end = indptr[u+1]
        for j in range(base, end):
            v = dsts[j]
            nd = d + ws[j]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v] = nd
                pv[v] = u
                pk[v] = j
                push(heap, (nd, v))
    return dist, pv, pk, settled
```
